rows.name: START POINT
rows.description: A new stone tower, on East point of Sanda Island, Ronaldsha Firth

rows.name: NORTH RONALDSHA
rows.description: A brick tower, 139 ft. high, on N. point of Orkney Islands

rows.name: SUMBURGH HEAD
rows.description: A stone tower, 55 ft. high, on the S. point of Zetland

rows.name: BRESSAY
rows.character: One rev. lt., 1 min.; red and white alternately
rows.description: White tower, 53 ft. high, on E. side of entrance to Lerwick

rows.name: WHALSEY SKERRIES
rows.description: A white tower, 98 ft. high, on Bound Skerry...

rows.name: NORTH UNST
rows.description: A white tower, 64 ft. high, on Muckle Flugga, N. part of island. The lt. is red towards the Skaw of Unst. Red between S.S.E. ½ E., and S.E. by E. ½ E.

rows.name: CAPE WRATH
rows.description: White tower, 65 ft. high. Flashes white and red alternately

rows.name: RU STOER
rows.description: White tower, 47 ft. high, on S. Ear. Visible 1 min. Eclipsed ½ min.

rows.name: SOUTH RONA
rows.description: White tower, 42 ft. high, on N.E. point of island

rows.name: Kyle Akin, Loch Alsh
rows.character: One br. or red fixed lt.
rows.description: On S.W. point of Gillean Island. Lt. bright in fairways of Applecross Sound and Loch Alsh. Red elsewhere

rows.name: Oronsay Island
rows.character: One br. or red fixed lt.
rows.description: White tower, 63 ft. high, on island, N.W. part of Sleat Sound

rows.name: BUTT OF LEWIS
rows.description: A white tower, 20 ft. high. Visible seaward from S. by E. ½ E. to W. by S. ½ S.

rows.name: Stornoway
rows.character: 1. One br. rev. lt. ½ min. 2. A reflected light
rows.description: 1. White tower, 45 ft. high, on Arnish Point... 2. A prism on beacon, on S.E. end of reef, reflects light from a lower window; visible in entering

rows.name: MONACH ISLES
rows.character: Upper lt., flashing 10. s. Lower lt., fixed red
rows.description: In one tower, 133 ft. high, on Shillay Island. Red lt. shown to northward, from N.W. by N. to N.E. by E.

rows.name: GLASS ISLAND
rows.description: White tower, 100 ft. high, on E. pt. of Scalpay, Harris Isles

rows.name: USHENISH
rows.description: East side of S. Uist. Shown between N.E. ½ N. and S.S.W.

rows.name: BARRA HEAD
rows.description: Visible 2½ min., and dark ½ min. On top of Bernera Island

rows.name: SKERRYVORE
rows.description: Granite tower, 158 ft. high, on the rock
